title: Querying the Tableau Server Repository: A Practical Guide to PostgreSQL Metadata
summary: How to pull governance-grade answers (permissions, view activity, RLS coverage) straight from Tableau's own repository database, without relying on the Metadata API.
overview: Every Tableau Server is backed by a PostgreSQL repository database that logs almost everything. This article walks through which tables matter, querying constraints, and dynamic RLS coverage validation.

title: Tableau Performance Tuning: Building Dashboards That Load in Under 2 Seconds
summary: Learn how to diagnose and optimize slow Tableau dashboards using Performance Recording, Hyper extracts, filter optimization, LOD expressions, and dashboard design best practices.
overview: This article covers the principles of diagnosing and fixing slow Tableau workbooks. You will learn to use Tableau Performance Recording to isolate rendering vs. query bottlenecks and apply concrete design adjustments to load dashboards under 2 seconds.
topics: Data Source Extract vs Live Strategies

title: Building Workbook Sentinel: Engineering a Secure Local-First Tableau Metadata Parser
summary: An engineering case study on designing a secure, local-first Tableau extension for metadata parsing, lineage analysis, and governance, covering architecture decisions, security verification, memory optimization, and browser compatibility.
overview: This article walks through the engineering journey behind Workbook Sentinel: a local-first Tableau Dashboard Extension that parses workbook metadata entirely within the browser sandbox. It covers four core challenges: eliminating data leakage, providing auditable security evidence, processing multi-GB packaged workbooks efficiently, and supporting legacy Tableau runtime environments.

title: SQL Performance Tuning & Execution Plan Mastery: Architecting Sub-Second Database Queries
